thread:
olga: Quick q — Legal wants assurance we preserve artifact metadata (checksums, redaction logs, uploader identity) when partners upload marketplace bundles. Specifically for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace flows. Anyone already have process? :eyes:

jmiller: We currently presign S3 objects and include metadata headers x-amz-meta-checksum, redaction-log-url. But marketplace ingestion sometimes strips headers. I think keeping a signed manifest inside the bundle is the most robust path.

sara: Can we require a signed manifest.json inside the tarball with sha256s and a redaction.tsv? That survives marketplace re-packaging and is easy for SI/HW partners to produce.

mike: +1. Example manifest snippet:
```
{
  "files": [{"path":"docs/sys_arch.pdf","sha256":"e3b0c442..."}],
  "redactions": "redaction-manifest.tsv",
  "signed_by": "redwood-kms:alias/marketplace-upload"
}
```

olga: Good. Legal: do you need chain-of-custody fields (uploader id, timestamp) on the manifest or is KMS signature enough?

legal: Include uploader_email, upload_ts, original_filename, and KMS key id. For pen-test artifacts we also need an attestation field listing who performed redaction and when. Also state retention policy in the manifest.

ida: For GCP we can store metadata as object attributes and attach a signed manifest. Azure marketplace sometimes re-packages packages during listing validation, so the internal manifest + a top-level human-readable checklist is important.

sec-bot: Pen-test artifacts must be labeled 'for-audit' and encrypted with the partner's public key. Also, emit an audit event with audit_id and artifact_sha to our audit-log service when the partner uploads.

jmiller: Action items: 1) define manifest schema (sha256s, redaction rows, uploader_email, upload_ts, kms_key) 2) update presign flow to return an ephemeral audit_id and store mapping 3) create partner-side examples for S3/GCS/Azure Blob 4) add checklist for marketplace listing teams.

sara: I'll draft the manifest schema and a minimal partner example (S3 presign + signed manifest) by EOD Tue. Will include sample command-line snippets for SI integrators.

olga: Thanks. Mike — can you own the checklist and the partner-facing one-pager? We need to avoid repeated back-and-forth when listings start.

mike: Yep — will add checklist in the partnerships repo and ping legal/ops for review, ETA Wed morning.

olga: :thumbsup:
